description: This file defines a Supabase integration class for logging events related to a language model, including input logs and response logs, with dynamic installation of the 'supabase' library if not present.

classes.name: Supabase
classes.description: A class to handle logging events and interactions with a Supabase database, including initializing the client and logging input and response events.

methods.name: __init__(self)

methods.description: Logs an input event to the Supabase table with model details and messages.

methods.description: Logs a response event, including response time, total cost, success or failure status, and response or error message.
